'''Keog Boorn''' was a male [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who surveyed uninhabited regions of the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. He worked for both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and its successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], noting that the latter paid better. Boorn investigated a possible signal from a [[Beckon call/Legends|beckon call]] emanating from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]; while he investigated the swamps, Boorn was scared away by a howl emanating from the swamps as he approached a [[Cave of Evil/Legends|cave straddled by a tree]].

==Biography==
Keog Boorn was an old scout who, [[18 BBY/Legends|about a year after]] the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], had been commissioned by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that had just emerged to capture the worlds of the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]]. After his sensors picked up strange signals during the second round of the swamp world of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], he followed the instructions of his contract with the Empire, which in these cases prescribed landing and further research. Deep in the swamps he came across a [[Cave of Evil/Legends|cave in a dark]], deformed tree from which the signals seemed to come. But before he could enter the cave there was a terrible scary scream that filled Boorn with fear. Terrified, he left the planet without further research and noted in his notes (the exploration report SS-176.01) that the planet was completely empty and uninhabited. Dagobah thus remained a safe exile for [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], who was sought by the Empire.
